verdict.rationale: Neon has some first-party event-driven behavior. Managed Better Auth webhooks let you handle authentication events with custom server logic, and the MCP tool surface lists triggers for Neon Functions. Both are thinly documented, auth-scoped or beta, and fall short of a general rule engine. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose rule/trigger definition system, trigger types and configuration details for Functions, events beyond authentication (database or branch events), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
